consistency.sentence:
Liquidity added to a position is locked for 7 days of block timestamp from its latest addition; removing it earlier reverts.
Conflicts with: Liquidity can always be removed while paused.
consistency.message: A liquidity lock conflicts with the other rule’s promise that liquidity can always be changed or removed. Remove one rule or compose an explicit compatible exception.
